ACTION=A2
Rationale: The structured context indicates there is a merging vehicle ahead starting to cut in from the right/left at $x = 16.0$ m and a crossing cyclist further down the road at $x = 23.0$ m. Since the ego vehicle is approaching these hazards at an initial speed of 50 kph, decelerating (braking) is necessary to maintain a safe following/yielding distance.
